steps.en: A daily run prepares the first reminder letters
steps.id: Proses harian menyiapkan surat pengingat pertama
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: Only due, unsuspended notices are chosen for the first letter
steps.id: Hanya notice jatuh tempo yang tidak disuspend dipilih untuk surat pertama

steps.en: Letters go to the owner's latest known address
steps.id: Surat dikirim ke alamat terbaru owner yang diketahui

steps.en: A data file with the letter details is created for the printer
steps.id: File data berisi rincian surat dibuat untuk percetakan

steps.en: The file is stored and sent for encryption
steps.id: File disimpan dan dikirim untuk dienkripsi

steps.en: The file reaches the printing vendor
steps.why_en: File delivery to the vendor is blocked by a setting in every environment.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman file ke vendor diblok oleh setelan di setiap environment.

steps.en: After sending, the notice moves on to the second reminder stage
steps.id: Setelah dikirim, notice pindah ke tahap pengingat kedua
steps.why_en: The notice moves on even when the file was not delivered because delivery is blocked.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap pindah tahap walau file tidak terkirim karena pengiriman diblok.
